# Warlock Sitemap

> Package: `@warlock.js/sitemap`

> A framework-blind sitemap builder: entries in, a valid sitemaps.org document out. Zero runtime dependencies.

## Skills

- [sitemap](@warlock.js/sitemap/skills/SKILL.md): Framework-independent XML sitemap builders: `Sitemap`, `SitemapIndex`, `buildSitemapXml`, `joinOrigin` and `SitemapEntry`. Use for "generate sitemap XML", URL metadata, hreflang, image entries, sharding, duplicate diagnostics or atomic publication from scripts and servers. Not this package → @warlock.js/web for Warlock page discovery, `/sitemap.xml` and robots routing; @warlock.js/core for app configuration.
